payload.friendly_name: pack-check CLI and its service release
payload.purpose_context: Issue #478, slice 8 of epic #549 (ADR-0075 decision 9). Today a consumer must build and start the whole charter service to validate packs. This mission ships pack-check: a standalone, Spring-free jar over pack-validation that checks one pack or a set of packs (per-pack PACK checks, the CLOSURE pack-set check, and optionally the round trip), answers in the API's problem JSON and codes with defined exit codes, and is published with its checksum on the service-v* release line (ADR-0046).
payload.purpose_tldr: Pack authors and spec-kitty-open-packs check packs with a released pack-check jar that runs the service's own checks, without running the service.

payload.final_answer: A: refuse every link inside the pack root with a new violation code in the one reader; fold and close #597; the pack root may be a link; Breaking note (operator via orchestrator, 2026-11-19)
A: PackCheckReport envelope as an additive contract schema; warnings on stderr (operator via orchestrator, 2026-11-19)
A: skip CLOSURE when a pack cannot be read into facts and report it; the unreadable pack is a violation, exit 1 (operator via orchestrator, 2026-11-19)
A: service-v0.1.0-rc.2 through a small release PR after the mission; tell the orchestrator the tag and commit when the native run is green (operator via orchestrator, 2026-11-19)

A: refuse links everywhere; no read follows a link; the store half refuses pack_entry_linked at load (operator via orchestrator, 2026-11-19)
